name: Remel
source:
Shuji gets into an accident resulting in memory loss. He feels like he enters the body of another person. While hospitalized he meets various people and gradually starts to come closer to understanding the truth behind his past.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
